claims: Dunkin' Rewards members can get a free hot or iced coffee of any size by entering the code STILLNOTAJOKE in the Dunkin' App.
The promotion is capped at 1,000,001 free coffees.
No purchase is necessary to redeem the offer.
The Dunkin' App offer is for a free hot or iced coffee or cold brew of any size.
A registered Dunkin' Rewards member is required to redeem the offer.
The offer is redeemed by entering the code in the "Offers" section of the Dunkin' app.
The offer is available while supplies last.
